title: Night Consumes
description: Small horror datapack built around the idea of neverending dark nights where you are safe only in the warmth of light.
body:
Small horror datapack built around the idea of neverending dark nights where you are safe only in the warmth of light.

I SLIGHTLY RECOMMEND TO PLAY THIS DATAPACK WITH PURE DARKNESS RESOURCE PACK AND NO SHADERS WITH DYNAMIC LIGHT.
Also to make sure that structures spawn, restart your world after putting the datapack in. 

Thanks to cinnamona123 for testing :D
(I hope it's not broken now)
